title: 'KPop Demon Hunters' star Ejae marries music producer Samuel Kim

blocks.text: Singer-songwriter Ejae, who rose to global fame with the hit song “Golden” from Netflix’s animated film “KPop Demon Hunters,” has married producer and songwriter Samuel Kim, also known as Sam Kim, in Seoul. The couple held an outdoor wedding Saturday, Oct. 17, at Stage 28 in Godeok-dong, Gangdong-gu, Seoul, according to an interview published Monday by Vogue. The venue holds special significance for Ejae, as it stands on the former residential property of her maternal grandfather, veteran Korean actor Shin Young-kyun.
